about: Annotated sentences for the verb-or-noun rule (SPEC.md, Shared logic). Identical in lingleaf-ios and lingleaf-android. word: the tapped form, its first whole-word, case-sensitive match in the sentence. expectedBase: the right base form in this sentence; expectedVerb: true when the form is a verb here. The rule may also be unsure (no claim: the word itself, no irregular link); each rule must be right (base and verb flag) in at least 95% of the cases where it claims. source 'constructed': written while designing the rule; 'heldout1': written after the first version was frozen (it showed the noun-subject rule firing on 'the finest felt' and led to the clause-start condition); 'heldout2': written after that version was frozen and never used to tune it; 'heldout3': written by the learning-content reviewer from the homograph list and this schema only; 'v2': written for the v2 steps (name or noun + lives/leaves, quantifier + plural noun, bit after a noun subject, opening participle, 'lost and found') before measuring them, with cases each step must leave alone; 'v2heldout': written after the v2 steps were frozen, never used to tune them; 'stories': every homograph in the bundled stories, the sentence as in the book. All sentences are original.
